cause: Fresh common.ini omitted the saved account/server selector and chart bar capacity. In addition, MT5 launches a child process whose PID differs from the short-lived bootstrap process; the first reader followed the bootstrap PID.
correction: Copy only saved Common environment/account/server/private/certificate selectors privately into own runtime; disable EA live trading and news; MaxBars2million. Track the actual exact-executable terminal child through process metadata, close only that owner. No account/position/order/deal API queries.
